name: glyhub_GPST000190_N
title: Linkage-specific sialic-acid derivatization of plasma N-glycans
description: Background-subtracted extracted-ion intensities of procainamide-labelled plasma N-glycans after linkage-specific sialic-acid derivatization.
details: The deposited complete extraction table contains 39 composition/retention features in two charge states across 54 LC-MS runs, including explicitly labelled blanks. Charge states remain separate measurement features rather than being summed without an author-defined rule. Am and E denote the source derivatization products used to distinguish alpha2,3- and alpha2,6-linked sialic acids; their counts are retained alongside the underlying Neu5Ac composition. Unmeasured charge states and reported zeros are missing in the curated assay. Run identifiers retain the original experimental batches; they are not interpreted as independent biological donors.
annotation: Composition-level glycans with source charge, retention time, procainamide label, and linkage-specific sialic-acid derivative counts; no full topology inferred.
